arguments.need: I use an AI coding assistant and I want it to be able to look through my repo, edit files, and run my project's checks, but I want guardrails so it can't write outside the project folder and so a stale passing test result doesn't count for newer edits. Is there a tool that plugs into my assistant over MCP, either locally over stdio or remotely over HTTP with OAuth? It also needs to be open source, and I'd like a terminal dashboard where I can see what the agent is doing and approve its access.
